description: Start here for any video longer than about 20 minutes. Returns the metadata and the video's chapters (or sections of about five minutes when it has none), each with its start time, a timestamp link and its estimated token count, plus the total. Then read only what you need with get_section (by chapter index or title, or by time). Fetches the transcript once (saved for later calls); the outline itself costs about 300 to 1,500 tokens.

language.description: Preferred transcript language (BCP-47, e.g. en, de). Default: the spoken language

mode.description: Transcript strategy: auto (captions, then speech-to-text), captions only, stt (always transcribe), video (multimodal model). Default: auto

url.description: Video URL (YouTube and more), a YouTube video id, or a local media file path

name: get_outline

sections.description: chapters: the video's own chapters; time: sections of about five minutes

title: Get video outline
